summary: Verified TTS Voice Selection & Preview feature. All 4 backend endpoints working correctly: GET /api/bible/tts/voices returns 6 voices (3 male, 3 female), POST /api/bible/tts/preview works for all voice IDs, PUT /api/admin/bible/settings saves voice preferences, GET /api/admin/bible/settings returns saved preferences.

minor.issue: Response time is slow (~30s), though this is expected since TTS service is not configured - returns informative message instead

passed_tests: GET /api/bible/tts/voices returns 3 male voices (sw-KE-Rafiki-Male, sw-TZ-Daudi-Male, en-US-Journey-Male)
GET /api/bible/tts/voices returns 3 female voices (sw-KE-Zuri-Female, sw-TZ-Amani-Female, en-US-Aria-Female)
Each voice has required fields: id, name, description, language, gender, sample_text
POST /api/bible/tts/preview works for sw-KE-Zuri-Female (returns voice_name: Zuri)
POST /api/bible/tts/preview works for sw-KE-Rafiki-Male (returns voice_name: Rafiki)
POST /api/bible/tts/preview returns 404 for invalid voice ID
POST /api/bible/tts/preview returns generated=false and informative message when TTS not configured
PUT /api/admin/bible/settings successfully saves default_voice_male and default_voice_female
GET /api/admin/bible/settings returns saved voice preferences correctly

POST_preview.message: TTS service not configured. Voice will work when Google Cloud TTS is set up.

critical_code_review_comments: Frontend BibleManagementPage.jsx correctly fetches voices from /api/bible/tts/voices
Voice selection UI displays male and female voices in separate sections with selection indicators
Preview buttons properly call /api/bible/tts/preview and handle audio playback
Save button correctly sends voice preferences to /api/admin/bible/settings
Existing listening settings are preserved when updating voice preferences
